item.title: Design Google Drive
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: File sync for 10 million users and 500 petabytes. Delta sync, why fixed-size blocks break the moment you insert a byte, content-defined chunking, conflict resolution that never loses data, and the deduplication trick that leaks information.
